name: project-scaffolder
description: Point it at a project directory and it works out which sub-projects live inside, then creates a matching sidebar folder for each one. The scan is read-only, so you see the whole list and tick what you want before anything is created. Sub-projects nest under their parent the way they do on disk, and anything you have already set up is shown but never created twice.
author: kirocrew
highlights: Scans read-only first, so nothing is created until you confirm a selection
Groups the preview by parent directory, with select-all and select-none per group
Confident matches start ticked; weaker ones are offered for you to opt into
Shows the signals behind each match, so you can see why a directory was picked
Folders you already have are listed but skipped, never duplicated
Reports exactly what was created, skipped, and what failed and why
